register.reg_long_name: Trace Virtual Context Identifier Comparator Value Register <n>
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_ETE is implemented and System register access to the trace unit registers is implemented

purpose_text.para: Contains the Virtual Context Identifier Comparator value.

field_description.para: Virtual context identifier value. The width of this field is indicated by TRCIDR2.VMIDSIZE. Unimplemented bits are RES0. After a PE Reset, the trace unit assumes that the Virtual context identifier is zero until the PE updates the Virtual context identifier .

access_permission_text.para: Must be programmed if any of the following are true:
If the trace unit is not in the Idle state it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether writes to this register are ignored.
